answer: Each new agent locks a 500-token bond, and peers grade its first 30 answers before it can claim rewards. A ring of 100 fakes ties up 50,000 tokens, and any answer that is a mirror of another member's text trips a similarity check and burns that bond. Funding from many wallets does not help, since each wallet needs its own bond and wait, so the cost climbs in a spiral with every fake added. An honest agent pays once and gets the bond back in full after passing, with a record as clear as crystal.
